name: local/run-plan
summary: Implementation Plan executor — mechanical AC-N preflight against the spec, runs an approved plan via implementer agents (multi-agent by DAG / owned paths, or single-agent), authors tests once via test-writer against the full changed set, gates with architecture-reviewer + plan-verifier in parallel, resolves their comments in a bounded fix loop, then a mechanical full-suite canary. Starts from a plan; no spec/planning here. Never pushes or merges.
